mentions.name: Claude-assisted German genealogy transcription
mentions.description: Personal genealogy research that uses Claude to transcribe old German cursive, especially for broad hits in non-indexed 17th-century parish records, which helped trace family lines further back on Ancestry.
mentions.source_excerpt: Noticed how well Claude works for transcribing old German cursive, especially for broad hits in non-indexed 17th century parish records. Motivated me to pick up Ancestry again and helped me quite a bit in following some lines further back.
mentions.author: josters
